Commentary.Commentary: The target is a huge one! India do have the fire power to chase this down but they will have to bat out of their skin. Can they do so? Australia will back themselves to defend this. Who will take a 1-0 lead?

The Indian bowling and fielding was off today! They did start decently but as the game progressed, their bowlers took a real pounding. Except for Shami, everybody went for over 6 per over. Also, a few dropped catches did not help their cause. Overall, India were very poor today.

Warner fell but Smith and Finch continued. The Australia skipper then got to his ton but fell shortly. Smith though continued. He was dropped early in his innings and he made India pay. He went berzerk and smashed the Indian bowlers to all parts of the ground. He got up his ton in no time. Maxwell's blitzkreig was also useful and the two ensured they have scored 25 runs more than what they seemed like they would score at one stage.

What a batting performance from Australia! Wow! Had they been given this score after winning the toss and electing to bat, they would have taken it with both hands. Have to say it is Smith who is the star but the foundation was laid from the opening pair as the two added 156.

Yes Shami can! Terrific final over from Shami. Just 6 off the final over. The last ball is a dipping full toss outside off. Carey comes inside his crease and looks to scoop it over th keeper's head but he misses. The batters steal a bye. AUSTRALIA FINISH WITH 374/6!
Excellent from Shami! Yorker on off, Carey jams it out back towards the bowler. Just 5 off the final over so far. Can Shami end it well?
Full around off, Cummins hits it to long off on a bounce. Gets a single to get off the mark.

OUT! BOWLED! End of a fantastic knock and Smith walks out to a standing ovation from his home crowd. Full toss on off, Smith looks to drive but misses. The ball hits the off pole. Disappointment for Smith, rspite for India. This has been a fantastic final over so far from Shami. Just 4 off the first half of the final over.
FOUR! Nobody moved! In the slot from Shami. It is full around off, Smith lifts it over cover for a boundary.
Perfect start to the final over for Shami. Off cutter outside off, Smith swings but misses.
Full on off, Smith comes inside the stumps and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single. A tough outing for Bumrah. We don't usually say that either maybe it is the rustiness. He finishes with 1/73!
Poor from Kohli and you don't say that often. Full on off, Carey drives it towards cover. Kohli lets the ball go between the legs which allows the batters to take three.
On off, Carey hits it straight to cover.
FOUR! A full toss and Carey accepts the gift! This is on off. Carey strokes it through covers and it races away to the fence.

HUNDRED FOR STEVEN SMITH! Incredible innings from Smudge! His 10th ODI ton! He has played a fabulous knock tofay. God length ball on off, Smith punches it to cover and gets a single to bring up his milestone. Smith removes his helmet and raises his bat as everyone applauds his supreme innings.
FOUR! Smartly played! Slower ball on off, Smith was ready for it and outsmarts Bumrah. He sweeps it through square leg and gets a boundary to move to 99!
A yorker to end! On middle. Smith jams it out towards cover for one.
A full toss, it is hit down to long off for one.
FOUR! 350 up! Short and outside off. This time Carey waits for it and then cracks it over the cover fielder for a boundary.
A short one and it is slower. Carey is early in the pull. He gets hit on the body.
Now looks to paddle but this is extremely full and outside off. It goes off the bottom towards the leg side for one.
SIX! What a shot that is! It is a slower one. Fuller and outside off. Smith lofts it over the cover fielder and it goes all the way.
A couple to end the over! Good running though. A very full ball on middle, Carey pushes it towards long on.
Yorker! Carey can do nothing but jam it back to Bumrah.
Length  ball on off, Smith looks to play on the off side. He opens the face of the bat a bit too early and it goes towards mid on for a run.
Yorker! A Bumrah special on middle and off. Carey looks to play it on the off side but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball goes to the off side and they take a single.
Slower ball wide outside off. Smith guides it towards cover and gets just a single.
Very full on the pads. Carey tickles it to fine leg for one.
Shorter and outside off. Smith looks to cut but is beaten.
Outside off, this is driven to the fielder at point for one.
Smith looks to paddle but the ball is outside off. He adjusts and guides it towards point for one.
Excellent! Fuller and around off, Smith guides it through backward point for two.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Smith looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Alex Carey is the new man in.
OUT! Labuschagne is a goner! Dhawan hangs onto one. This is full and on middle. Labuschagne lofts it towards long off. Dhawan runs to his right and takes a good catch.
A full toss but not very high. Smith pushes it towards cover for one. The batter was taken by surprise.
Fuller and on off, this is hit down to long off for two.
Marnus Labuschagne replaces Maxwell out in the middle.

OUT! MAXWELL HOLES OUT! He has done his job though! This is full and on middle. Maxwell smashes it down towards the long on fielder. He does not get the desired elevation. Jadeja there makes no mistake.
FOUR! Cheeky! Brilliant! The reverse sweep is out. It is full and outside off. Maxwell plays it nice and fine for a boundary.
Short and outside off. Maxwell looks to pull but misses.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
SIX! The boundaries continue to flow! Welcome back into the attack Shami! Short and on middle. Smith stands tall and pulls it hard over the square leg fence.
FOUR! This is in the gap! Outside off, Maxwell squeezes it over cover-point and it goes for a boundary. A huge over for Australia.

DROPPED AND FOUR! Tough chance though. It is fuller and outside off. Maxwell lofts it towards deep cover. Iyer goes for the catch which is the right call. He dives foward and tries to take it but the ball bursts through and goes behind for a boundary.
An appeal but nothing! This is full and outside off. Maxwell goes after it. There is a noise as the ball passes the bat. Rahul appeals but nothing.
Outside off, Maxwell feels it is a wide and leaves it. Nothing from the umpire.
SIX! HUGE! This is fuller and on middle.Maxwell clears his front leg and heaves it into the mid-wicket stand.
Shorter and outside off, it is pushed throughy covers for one.

DROPPED AND SIX! Hardik Pandya is the guilty party. India have looked sloppy in the field today. We do not usually say that about this Indian side. Floated on off, Maxwell looks to clear sweeper cover. He does not time it well. Hardik comes ahead a bit too early. He then looks to correct the mistake and looks to go back. Too late as his outstretched hand can just parry the ball over the rope.
Down the leg side. Maxwell looks to sweep but gets a little bat on it. KL Rahul, behind the stumps, misses it and they take two.
Short around off. Maxwell knocks it to long on, away from the fielder and gets a couple.
SIX! This is even better! Flighted on off and middle. Maxwell gets into the position early and reverse sweeps it over the point fence for a biggie. Incredible!
FOUR! Innovative and gutsy from Maxwell. Floated outside off, Maxwell reverse sweeps it over backward point for a boundary.
On the pads, Smith turns it behind square leg and gets to the other end.
Length ball on middle and off. Smith drives it but finds short mid-wicket.
WIDE! Bumrah overcooks the bouncer. It goes well over the head of Smith.
On the pads, SS turns it to the leg side and rotates.
Short ball on middle, Maxwell pulls it to square leg for a single.
Short on middle, Smith flicks it to the on side for a single.
Good length and around off, Maxi forces through cover for one.
FOUR! Wonderfully played! Full and wide outside off, Maxwell drills it through covers for a boundary.
Maxwell is off the mark! Flighted on off, Maxi nudges it to cover and keeps the strike with one.
Short outside off. Maxwell slaps it but finds point.
Glenn Maxwell walks out to bat!

OUT! CAUGHT! Stoinis walks back for a golden duck! He will be gutted and fuming inside. Chahal gets his first and India slowly making a comeback in this game. Short pitching around off and it turns away from Stoinis. He looks to punch it on the off side but the turn on the ball sees it kiss the outside edge. KL Rahul behind the stumps takes a good sharp catch.
Flighted around off, Steven pushes down to long on for a single.
SIX! SMOKED! That was six the moment it left the bat! Tossed up around off, Smith slg sweeps it over mid-wicket. There is a fielder in the deep but he is just a mere spectator.
Floated on off, Smith pushes it to the left of the bowler.

OUT! CAUGHT! Soft dismissal to end a terrific innings from skipper, Aaron Finch!  Stop the press as Bumrah's ODI wicket drought is finally over. Short ball, a well-directed one which lacks pace as well. Finch looks to gude it over the keeper's head but the lack of pace sees him just guide it high in the air. KL Rahul runs behind to his left and takes a simple catch. Perfect way for India to finish Powerplay 2!
Marcus Stoinis walks out to bat! Also, Powerplay 3 begins. Now a maximum of 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the end of the innings.
On the pads, Finch flicks it to the ight of fine leg and gets a couple.
Length ball around off. Finch looks to run it down to third man but chops it on the crease.
FOUR! Poor from Bumrah! The fine leg is up but he still bowls it on the pads. Finch tickles it to fine leg and gets another boundary.

FOUR! Oh m, what have you done Agarwal! On the pads, Finch flicks it to the right of deep mid-wicket. Mayank Agarwal at deep mid-wicket runs to that side but seems to have lost the ball in the sunshine and the ball goes away from him and to the fence.

DROPPED! Brilliant effort from Chahal but he cannot hold onto it. Fuller on the pads, Finch flicks it uppishly to the left of short fine leg. Chahal dives and gets his hands to it but cannot hold onto it. Two taken.
SIX! Handsome and effective from Smith. Tossed up around off, Smith plays the most difficult shot, the inside out shot. He makes it look easy and lofts it over extra cover for a biggie.
Shorter on off, Finch tucks it to mid-wicket and gets  a single.

HUNDRED FOR FINS! His first in SCG! Such a beautiful knock this has been from the skiper. He has led from the front. Floated around off, Finch flicks it through mid-wicket and gets a couple to get to his ton. The crowd is on its feet to applaud. The Australian skipper makes a tribute to his the late Phil Hughes as he then proceeds to remove his helmet and raise it along with the bat as everyone in the stadium applauds the skipper's efforts.
Tossed up on middle,  SS flicks it to deep mid-wicket and gives the strike to Aaron Finch.
FOUR! This time gets in the gap and gets a boundary. Short around off, it is half tracker and Smitch is happy to punch it through cover-point for a boundary.
Floated around off, Smith punches it but finds cover inside the circle.
Around off, Smith dabs it to third man and keeps the strike.

The wait continues as Finch moves to 99! Fuller on off and middle, Finch nudges it to the left of long on. He thinks he can get two but the fielder is quick to clean it up and keep the Australian skipper waiting on 99!
Around middle and leg, SMith flicks but gets just a single this time.

FOUR! FIFTY FOR STEVEN SMITH! Another easy picking for Smith. It is on the pads, Smith just flicks it through backward square leg to get to his fifty. He did not start off well but has slowly found his groove in this innings and looks set now.
FOUR! Early Christmas present for Smith. Overpitched on middle, asking to be hit. Smith says thank you very much and flicks it delightfully through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full on middle, Finch milks it through mid on to move 2 away from a well-deserved century.

IN THE AIR AND FOUR! Shikhar Dhawan has made a complete mess of it. Floated on middle and off. Smith goes for a sluggish slog over mid-wicket. He gets a tp edge which goes towards long on. Dhawan there is standing too far inside the ropes. He runs back and raises his hand to take it but he cannot get anything on it and goes away to the fence on the bounce.
Short on middle, Smith taps it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Cut and cut away fine! Short outside off, Smitch cuts it in the gap through point for a boundary.
FOUR! This time connects and gets a boundary! Tossed up fuller around off, Smith lifts his drive over covers for a boundary.
Short outside off. Smith looks to punch but misses and falls over. KL Rahul whips the bails quickly but luckily Smith's back foot does not leave the crease.
Flatter on middle and off. Smith pushes it to mid-wicket.
On off, the former Australian skipper punches it through covers and keeps the strike.
On the pads. Finch looks to flick but misses. The ball kisses his pad and goes to the on side for leg bye.
Length ball on off, Smith flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
WIDE! Shami overcooks the bouncer as it goes over the head of Smith.

Excellent stop from Kohli! The captain leading from the front on the field. Full on middle, Smith flicks it right of the meat of his bat to the right of mid-wicket. Kohli there dives and saves at least 3 for his side.
On the pads, Finch flicks it to the leg side for a single. Moves to 97!
Fuller ball on off. Smith closes the face of the bat a bit too soon. The ball goes to third man off the outer half of his bat to the right of third man for a single.
On off,  Aaron keeps it out. The Australian skipper will have to wait for his century.
Darted quicker on middle and leg. Finch tucks it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on middle, Finch plays it away from long on and gets a couple to move to 96!
Floated on middle, Finch tapsit back to the bowler.
Good fielding! Floated on middle and off, Smith sweeps it to the right of deep mid-wicket. Iyer there runs to that side and keeps it down to one with a dive.
Smith milks another couple. Floated around off, Smith drives it wide of long off for a brace.
Good length delivery on off. Finch hops and defends it to cover.
Driven nicely but straight to the fielder.  Full around off, Finch drives it straight to cover.
Good length ball outside off, Finch punches it behind point and gets another couple.  The partnershi motors to 47 off just 37 balls.
Another short ball but this time Smith pulls it off the upper half of his bat for a single.
FOUR! Perfectly placed! Short ball on middle, Smith pulls it in front of square and in the gap for a boundary.
Fuller around off. Finch drives it to point for a single.
WIDE! Full toss but down the leg side. Finch looks to flick but misses.
A dot to end! On middle, this is pushed towards mid on. The fielder at mid-wicket runs to his left, dives and stops it. End of an action-packed over.
FOUR! Nicely played! This is adding salt to the wound. Smith comes down the track and whips it uppishly It is wide of deep mid-wicket and a boundary results.

NOT OUT! That is going over! Australia now review correctly. Smith survives. This is on middle. It straightens a touch. Smith looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. He is hit above the knee roll. An appeal and up goes the finger. Smith reviews after a chat and replays show it to be going over.
Fires it on the pads, Smith looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Smith has been adjudged LBW but he has taken it upstairs.
Smith looks to play the slog sweep but it goes off the inner half through square leg for two.
On off, Smith looks to go over covers but it goes off the inner half back to the bowler.
FOUR! Too short and wide! Put away! Another good over for Australia. Short and outside off. Finch stands tall and cuts it over point. No chance for the man in the deep.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Good length and on off, Finch drops it towards cover and takes one.
Fuller and on the pads, this is worked throughs square leg for one.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for two.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
A dot to end but a good over for Australia. On middle, defended.
Another two! Sees Finch coming down the track and bowls it wide outside off. Finch hits it through wide mid off and takes two.
Slightly shorter and around off, this is slapped through covers for two.
Now creams this through covers for one.
FOUR! Lovely! Uses his feet brilliantly. It ends up being a full toss. Smith hits it over mid-wicket and bags a boundary.
Very full and on middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
Short ball outside off. Smith flat-bats it off the lower half of his bat to mid off.
Length ball on off, SS defends it to point and shouts a loud no.
A very classy shot! Good length ball around off, Smith drives it on the up away from sweeper cover for a couple.
Good length ball just outside off. Finch opens the face of the bat and guides it towards third man for one.
On the pads, Finch flicks it away from deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Length ball on off, Smith guides it through point for one.
FOUR! Punished! Chahal pays for the extra delivery! Short on leg, Finch finds the gap between mid-wicket and square leg and gets another boundary.

Floated around off, Smith lunges forward and drives it to sweeper cover for a single to get off the mark. Hold on! Criminal from Chahal as he has overstepped his line. Free Hit to follow and it will be Finch who will get the freebie.
Short and spinning away from Smith. He taps it to point.
Nicely looped up delivery on middle and off. Smith comes down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
Tossed up on middle, Finch flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted on off, Finch finds his counterpart again at cover.
Good stop! Floated around off, Finch hits it hard to the right of short cover. Kohli there dives and saves runs for his side.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed to mid on. End of a successful over from Shami.
Who will walk out to bat  at number 3? Will it be the former skipper, Steven Smith who will join the current one or will we see a surprise? No surprise as Steven Smith walks out at number 3!

OUT! There is a spike and Warner has to walk back! That is the wicket India so desperately needed! Excellent use of the technology. Shami goes full and wide outside off. Warner looks to jam it out behind point but there is a sound as the ball passes the bat. Rahul takes it and appeals. The umpire shakes his head. Kohli reviews and he is very confident. Replays roll in and it shows that Warner has hit the ground too but he does so after the ball passes the bat. Also, the spike is when the ball passes the bat and hence, the on-field decision has to be overturned. End of a very good innings and a brilliant partnership for Australia. Is this the opening India needed? Can they capitalize on this?
Review time! India think they have got Warner caught behind. The on-field umpire does not think so. Kohli has opted for a review. Let's see what the replays have to say.
2 runs, that is punched off the back foot for a couple.
FOUR! Dispatched! Slightly short and Warner picks the length early. He smashes it over the mid-wicket fielder for another boundary.
Half an appeal but nothing! On off, Finch looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the off side for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
A single to end! On off, it is pushed through covers. A good over for Australia.
A couple! Finch once again uses his feet and hits this hard down towards long on. Two.
! All the way! Finch uses his feet and gets to the pitch of the ball. He lofts it over the long on fence for a maximum.
FInch comes down the track but the length is short. He tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
One more single as this is pushed down to long off.
On off, it is pushed through covers for one.
A couple to end! Shorter and outside off. Warner slashes at it. It goes off the underedge fine on the off side. Two.
Very full and on middle, this is pushed to the man at mid off.
No run, that is punched off the back foot, but not in the gap.
Finch played that really late! On off, he guides it towards third man for one.
Length and on off, it is pushed towards wide mid off for one. The fielder fumbles but it stays to one.
On the body, not giving the batter room to play with. It is worked to mid-wicket.

Once again single off the last ball. On middle and leg, Warner milks it to long on and keeps the strike. Halfway stage of the innings has gone and Australia are in a commanding position here. The hosts are 134/0!
Tossed up on middle, Warner pushes it back to the bowler.
Short on middle, Warner cannot find the gap.
On the pads, David Warner flicks it but finds mid-wicket.
Shorter on off, Warner punches it away from sweeper cover for a couple.
FOUR! Very well played. Fuller on middle and off. Warner chnages the grip on the handle and switch hits it through backward point for a boundary.
Gets the single of the last ball. Good over from Yuzvendra Chahal. Just that single off it. The last ball is on the pads, Warner flicks this away from short mid-wicket and keeps the strike.
5 dots in the over now. Shortish top spinner on middle. Warner tucks it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off and middle. This was overpitched but Warner finds short mid-wicket with his flick.
On the pads, Warner flicks it but once again cannot go past the fielder.
Flatter on off. Warner plays it to mid on.
Floated around off. Warner calmly defends it.
Darted quicker on the pads, Finch turns it but finds mid-wicket inside the circle.
FOUR! Slogged away! Finch is looking extremely comfortable out in the middle now. Full on off, Finch lifts it with minimum of fuss over mid-wicket and away from the fielder for a boundary.
Flatter and around off, bunted down to mid on for a single.

FIFTY FOR WARNER! His 22nd fifty in this format and this has been a very good knock from the southpaw. He has played really well and will look to convert this into a big one. On the pads, Warner flicks it through square leg and gets a coupe.
Shorter on middle. Warner tucks it to mid-wicket and takes a step forward. He quickly shouts no allowing Finch ample time to get back in.
Tossed up around off. Finch milks it to long on and eases to the other end.
On off, Warner defends it to get through the over.

FOUR LEG BYES! Warner charges down the track while moving away from the stumps. Bumrah follows him and bowls it on the pads. Warner looks to flick but he misses. The ball kisses his pads and goes fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Bouncer! A well-direct one from around the wicket to the southpaw. Warner sways away from it. Oh wait a minute. Bumrah has overstepped and it is a No Bal! Free Hit coming up!

Low full toss on middle. Finch guides it to the right of mid on and hurries for the single. Hardik charges to the ball from mid on but fumles while trying to pick it up allowing Finch to get the single with relative ease.
Full on middle, Finch strokes it but straight to mid on.
Now gently flicks it towards square leg and rotates the strike. Smart and sensible from the southpaw.
FOUR! Slammed! Wonderful and powerful from Warner. Short around off, Warner pulls it in the gap through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flat and short on off. Finch defends it to the right of Jadeja.
Another flick and another single this time for David Warner.
Short on middle and off. Finch plays it towards long on. Jadeja looks to stop but gets blocked by Warner who does not move. Single taken.
Short on off. Warner tucks it to mid-wicket for a run.
This time Finch stays in his crease and whips it to the on side for one.
Ohh! Floated around off. Finch comes down the track and looks to flick. He gets an inside edge and the ball lobs off his pad. Luckily for him it fals well away from Jaddu.
Very full and on middle, this is pushed to mid on. A tidy over from Bumrah.
Shorter and on middle, Finch pulls it with one leg up in the air towards deep square leg for one.
On middle again, Finch works it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length and on off, Finch pushes it to covers.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.

A direct hit and Finch was a goner! By a long, long way that too. It is on middle. Finch pushes it to mid on and takes off. Jadeja gets to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Jadeja normally does not miss. This time he does though. Fortunate Finch.
Change in bowling. Jasprit Bumrah is back into the attack. 4-0-23-0, his numbers so far.
100 up for Australia. This is the ideal start for them. Outside off, it is guided towards short third man. There is a slight hesitation as it goes to that fielder but a misfield means an easy run.
On middle, blocked.
On the pads, Warner works it throughs square leg for one.
! A really good innings so far. Started off slowly but is into his elemnent now. He gets there by pushing it through covers for one. Can he make it big?
On off, it is pushed to covers.
Fires it on middle, it is worked back to the bowler.
Two to end a brilliant over for Australia! Fuller and on off, Warner hits it wide of long off and takes two.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Finch comes down the track and Chahal shortens the length. It is worked past backward square leg for two.
Quicker and on middle, defended.
SIX! THUMPED! That is right off the middle. FInch finally gets one away. This is tossed up nicely and on off. It is a little too full. Finch heaves it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Tosses it up on the pads, Chahal looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Shorter and down the leg side. Warner misses the pull. Rahul fails to collect it cleanly. A single and it is also a wide.
A dot to end another very good over by Jadeja. On middle, defended.

A huge, huge appeal but nothing in the end! This is fired on the pads. Finch looks to sweep but it goes off something to the keeper. Rahul puts in a confident appeal but the umpire shakes his head. India do not review after a disucssion. It might be off the pads.
Fires it on middle, it is eased down to long on for one.
Finch comes down the track and then swings. It goes off the inner half down to long on for one.
Fires it on off, blocked.
Fuller and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
One more single as this is worked off the pads through square leg.
On middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
Quicker and on off, Finch pushes it to covers.
Slower and wide outside off. Looking to tempt the batter to go big. Finch lets it be. Wided.
On middle, defended.

Just out of the reach! Luck in Australia's favor at the moment! This is tossed up nicely outside off. Finch looks to go over covers but ends up slicing it up towards point. Dhawan runs back and dives foward but it is out of reach. Two taken. Tremendous effort though from him.
Slightly short and outside off, it is cut to point.
On the pads, Finch flicks it to the on side and keeps the strike. Tidy first over from Jadeja.
WIDE! Jadeja misses his line and bowls one down the leg side.

Another appeal for LBW but once again turned down. Floated around off, Finch lunges forward and loks to defend. The Australian skipper gets hit on the pad. There is an appeal but turned down. Indication was that there is some edge on it. Replay later on shows that the impact was umpire's call.

Appeal for LBW but turned down by the umpire. Darted quicker outside off. Finch comes down the track and looks to whip but misses. The ball hits him on the pad. Jadeja appeals but the umpire is not keen.
Flighted on off, Warner milks it to long on for a single.
Short and a little bit of turn for Jadeja. Warner tucks it to mid-wicket.
Jadeja starts with a fullish ball on off. Finch whips it to long on for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Warner calmly defends it and gets through the over.
A charge down the wicket from Finch. He drags it from outside off towards wide long on for a run.
Smart cricket from Warner. Fllows the boundary with a single towards long off.
FOUR! First attack against spin and it is a succesful one. Flighted and overpitched on off. It is in the zone for Warner. He hits it with the spin, in the gap over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Floated on off, Finch taps it towards point and takes a single. The running between the wickets between this pair has been very good so far. run.
Darted fuller on off and middle. Warner strokes it to long on for a single.

DRINKS! A very good start here for the Aussies. The duo of Finch and Warner have played well so far and are looking good out in the middle. The pitch has looked terrific to bat on so far. The Aussies will hope thir openers can continue their stand and make a massive one. Kohli will hope his spinners can spin some magic and give the the breakthough they are lookin for.
Shorter and on the body. Finch looks to pull but is early in the shot. It goes off the bottom end towards mid-wicket.
On off, this is pushed to the right of mid off for one more.
Two more! Fuller and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket.
Back of a length and on off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is clipped through mid-wicket. Two taken.
A bumper but way too high! Wided as Finch lets it go over him.
Angled into middle, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Quicker and on off, Finch guides it to point. End of a tidy over from Chahal.
Lovely from Chahal! Changes his pace and bowls it full on middle. It is pushed back to the bowler.
Finch comes down the track and Chahal shortens his length. Finch looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Quicker and on off, it is pushed back to the bowler.
Shorter and outside off, Finch guides it to point.
On the pads, this is worked towards square leg for one.
Starts off with one down the leg side. He probably bowled that as Warner initially looked to shape up for the reverse sweep. Wided as Warner lets it alone.
Change in bowling. Spin into the attack for the first time in this game. Leg spinner,  Yuzvendra Chahal is introduced into the attack.
1 run, played towards covers.
A good short one! Warner initially looks to pull but then bails out. A good over so far from Saini. Can he end it well?
Length and on off, it is pushed to covers.
Shorter and on middle, Warner works it to mid-wicket. Finch wants a run but is sent back in time.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
A little too straight, this is worked behind square on the leg side for one.
Powerplay 2 signalled by the umpire. Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
A dot to end a very good Powerplay 1 for Australia. They are 51 for 0 after it. THe last ball is fuller and on middle. It is pushed to mid on.
Finch gets right behind the line and defends it.
Shorter and on the pads, this is worked behind square on the leg side for one.
Fifty up for Australia! This is a good start for them! Angled into the pads. Finch looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket.
Angled into the pads. Finch looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Change in bowling. Mohammed Shami is back on. Change of ends for him as he will bowl the final over of Powerplay 1! 0/12 from his first 3 overs.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket. A good over for Australia. But Saini did well to bowl three dots to end it. 9 from it.
Back of a length and on off, Warner stays back and defends it onto the ground.
Swing and a miss! Length and outside off. Warner looks to go over the off side but is beaten.
FOUR! Nice and easy! Shorter and on the body. Warner works it behind square on the leg side and it races away to the fence. Second boundary in the over. Saini has not started well.
Shorter and on the body. Finch looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the body. It rolls beside the pitch for one.
FOUR! Uppish but in the gap! Fuller and outside off. Finch goes hard after it. It is uppish but through covers for a boundary. Saini's over once again starts off with a boundary.
Tidy from Bumrah! Back of a length and on off, Warner defends it.
Nicely timed but for no runs! Back of a length and on off, Warner guides it to cover-point.
Easy two! Full and on the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket.
Back of a length and on off, Warner guides it to backward point.
Angled into the pads, Finch looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the leg side for one.
On middle, this is worked to the man at mid on.

Brilliant from Jadeja! He saves a certain boundary. Length and outside off. Finch times it towards point. Jadeja dives to his right and makes a half stop. Just a single. Excellent comeback from Saini. Just a five from the over despite going for a boundary early on.
Back of a length and on middle, Finch works it to mid-wicket.
Quick from Saini! It is short and on off, Finch looks to pull but is hurried into the shot. It is mistimed towards mid-wicket.
Better from Saini! Back of a length and on off, Finch stands tall and defends it onto the ground.
Saini gets away with one! It is short and wide outside off. Finch slashes at it but mistimes it towards point.
FOUR! Loose to begin with by Saini! Short and wide outside off. Finch gets on top of the bounce and cuts it through point. It races away to the fence.
A delay to Saini's first over as it looks like there is a pitch invader. Not what anyone likes to see.
First bowling change of the game as Navdeep Saini replaces Mohammed Shami. Let's see how the speedster fares in his first.
A very low full toss on middle. Almost a yorker, Warner does well to defend it.

Single now! Length ball on off, Finch taps it to the left of mid on and takes a quick run.That brings up the 5000 runs for Aaron Finch in ODIs. A cheer from the fans who are back in the ground after a long time. Good to hear those applause.
Much better from Bumrah. Hits the good length area around off. The ball hits Finch's bat hard as he defends it off the front foot.
Bumrah hits the deck hard on off. Finch tucks it to the leg side.

FOUR! Finch getting into his strides now. Very good shot this from the Australian skipper. Bumrah is struggling at the moment. He bangs it in short but the ball does not bounce and it is in the zone for Finch. He pulls it with power and good use of his wrists through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short ball down the leg side. Finch bends under it. Close call but the umpire is happy with it.
Good length and on off, Warner defends it. 19 from the last two overs.
Wide outside off, Finch goes after it. It flies off the outside edge down towards third man for one.
Another three! This is fuller and on middle. Warner lofts it over the bowler's head. Not off the middle. The fielder from mid on hares after it and pulls it back before it crosses the ropes.
Runs now coming for Australia. On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for three.
Edgy runs! Length and on off, it pitches and then shapes away. Finch looks to defend but it goes off the outside edge and fine on the off side. Two taken.
On of, Warner plays it to the off side and gets a single.

NOT OUT! The dive saves Warner! A back of a length delivery on off, it is pushed towards mid off and the batters go for one. Mayank Agarwal gets to the ball and underarms it onto the stumps at the bowler's end as he dives foward. An appeal and it is a very confident one by the Indians. They are celebrating, Warner though looks calm and thinks he is in. Replays show that Warner is in by just. He is really quick.
Run Out appeal taken upstairs. Direct hits are always a touch and go. Let's see if Warner's dive has saved him or not. Big moment in the game.
Back of a length and on off, defended.
BEATEN! Shorter and outside off, Warner slashes but misses. A little bit of extra bounce there.
Brilliant running! On a length and around off, Warner guides this down towards third man. They take one and go for the second. Complete it.

Wayward from Bumrah! This is down the leg side. Finch misses the flick. It keeps moving away. Rahul does well to dive to his left and get a hand to it. The batters take one and then think of a second but Finch slips as he turns.
A little straighter this time and on a length. Defended towards mid on.

FOUR! Uppish but wide! That should break the shackles for Finch! It is a length delivery. Finch hits it on the up and uppishly but wide of mid off for a boundary. So Bumrah concedes consecutive boundaries.
End of another brilliant over from Shami! On off, Finch pushes it towards mid off for one.
First sign of aggression from Finch! He steps down and Shami shortens the length a touch. It is also wide outside off. Finch looks to go over covers but misses.
Continues to hit the length hard and on off, Finch defends it nicely.
Hits the length hard again and on middle. Finch works it to mid-wicket.
Length and around off, Finch defends it nicely.
Length and around off, it comes back in a touch. Finch looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

FOUR! First boundary of the game and the last ball spoils the over. The slightest of width on offer and Warner makes Bumrah pay. He guides it through cover-point and it races away. Just used the pace of the bowler there. Good shot.
Bowls the yorker on off, Warner gets his bat down and jams it back to the bowler.
Finch now gets off the mark! On middle, this is worked towards mid on for one.
Slightly fuller and on off, non movement so far for Bumrah. It is pushed to mid off.
Another excellent run! Back of a length and on off, Warner drops it on the off side again. Finch goes for it. He avoids a collision with the bowler who runs towards the ball and then dives to get in.
Bumrah too starts on the money! Length and on off, Warner defends it nicely.
Who will operate with the second new ball? It will be the ever impressive, Jasprit Bumrah!
Gets away with the last ball but a top over by Shami! The last nut is down the leg side. Finch looks to flick but misses. It goes off the pads to the keeper.
Excellent from Shami so far! Length and on off again. Finch once again hops and defends it.
Some away movement for Shami! Length and outside off, moves away. Easy leave.
Back of a length and on middle. Finch hops and works it to mid-wicket.
Australia and Warner are underway! Length and on off, Warner drops it on the off side and takes one. The two run really well together and there is one example.
A peach to begin with! Length and around off, moves away with the angle. Warner initially looks to have a poke at it but just pulls his bat back right at the end.

Done and dusted wth the national anthems and we are all set for the action to begin! The Indian players are in a huddle with their skipper, Virat Kohli giving final words of motivation before his troops take their respective position in the field. Australian skipper, Aaron Finch walks out with David Warner to open the innings for the hosts. Mohammed Shami to start with the new ball for India. Two slips in place for him to begin with.
Both sets of players walk out to the middle for their respective national anthem. We are not far away from the start of action.
India Playing XI - Shikhar Dhawan, Mayank Agarwal, Virat Kohli (C), Shreyas Iyer, KL Rahul (WK), Hardik Pandya, Ravindra Jadeja, Mohammed Shami, Yuzvendra Chahal, Jasprit Bumrah, Navdeep Saini.
Australia Playing XI - Aaron Finch (C), David Warner, Steven Smith, Marcus Stoinis, Marnus Labuschagne, Glenn Maxwell, Alex Carey (WK), Pat Cummins, Mitchell Starc, Adam Zampa, Josh Hazlewood.

Indian skipper, Virat Kohli, says they want to start strongly and it is important for them to start well. Mentions they were given a few allowances to train and the boys took it well, says it was very well organized by the Australian board. Informs Agarwal will open as he has been doing well. Adds Pandey, Natarajan, Gill and Samson miss out.

Australian skipper, Aaron Finch, says that it is great to have cricket back in Australia along with the fans and tells he is really excited. Finch says that Steven Smith replaces Marsh from their last playing XI. Finch hopes they can put runs on the board and expects it to spin later on.

TOSS - We are all in readiness for the spin of coin. The Australian skipper, Aaron Finch is joined by Indian skipper, Virat Kohli and the match referee. Up goes the coin, Virat calls Heads but it comes down as Tails. AUSTRALIA OPT TO BAT!

PITCH REPORT - Brendon Julian and Mark Waugh are down for the pitch report. Waugh says SCG is a big ground and renowned for spin. Tells the outfield is quick and it is a high scoring ground. Julian feels it looks like a good pitch to bat on and tells there is a bit of grass. Waugh agrees but feels there is no shine on it and expects it to be an even pitch. Waugh feels that Australia have a good bowling attack. On being asked if he feels India will play both Kuldeep and Chahal, Waugh thinks they will play Jadeja and one spinner.
It's all about bragging right and who will get it? Hope you are ready for what promises to be a cracker of a contest.  Stay tuned for the toss and further updates.

The last time Aaron Finch's Australia played ODI's they outplayed the World Champions in their own backyard and now they will look to kick off the Australian cricketing summer with a win over a strong Indian side.
The Virat Kohli led side are all set to play after a gap of more than 8 months. No Rohit Sharma, which has stolen much of the headline. It will be interesting to see who opens and plays this game.

Hello and welcome to the 1st ODI between Australia and India. A lot of chats, a lot of build-up and a lot of excitement heading into this. All that talk now is left behind as the two heavyweights finally go up against each other.
